Latin word

paucī

paucī, paucae, pauca

adjective, plural, declension

a few; few, a few; a few, the few

In this lexicon

  • couple

    also used · classical · Catull. 13.1–2: paucīs … diēbus

  • few

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Amic. 2: paucī admodum familiārēs; Traupman 314

  • minority

    also used · classical · Cic. Leg. 3.32: paucī enim atque admodum paucī

Examples

  • paucīs temeritās est bonō, multīs malō

    rashness turns out well for a few, and badly for manyPhaedr. 5.4.12

    In the entry for few

  • Paucōrum est intellegere, quid dōnet diēs.

    Few understand what the day is giving.Publ. P 53

    In the entry for few

  • paucī enim atque admodum paucī honōre et glōriā amplificātī vel corrumpere mōrēs cīvitātis vel corrigere possunt

    for a few, a very few, raised high by office and fame, can either corrupt a people’s ways or reform themCic. Leg. 3.32
